description.en:
TRON 2 is LimX Dynamics' modular embodied-robot platform. A common system can be configured for dual-arm manipulation, bipedal movement or wheeled-leg operation, allowing researchers to explore different physical arrangements without starting from a completely separate platform.

LimX provides development tools, model and data examples, and documentation for teleoperation, control and deployment. Its dual-arm configuration targets vision-language-action research and manipulation, while the legged configurations support work on terrain adaptation and mobility. Accessories and configuration determine the available functions. The platform is intended to connect model development with experiments on real hardware.
